proxy: task-disjoint offline action and trajectory evaluation on FreeTacMan

supporting_resources.RCT: perception-only supporting benchmark; CC BY 4.0; public splits/code
supporting_resources.HapTile: behavioral dataset and baselines described, public access details not independently verified
supporting_resources.ForeTac-VLA: recent real-world prior; public reproduction substrate not verified

minimum_protocol.split: episode-disjoint and task/category-disjoint where metadata permits
minimum_protocol.download_policy: predeclared task subset only; record bytes and hashes

limitations: offline action error is not closed-loop task success
full release is 50.3 GB and subset sizes need preflight measurement
official task-disjoint split and checkpoint were not verified
source data collection used custom tactile hardware, although consumption does not

reviewer.strongest_objection: Logged-action prediction may reward demonstrator style and does not establish closed-loop success or causal physical grounding.
